rows.name: Resources.RoundedRecurrence.ceil_affine_lt_add_one
rows.raw_header:
theorem ceil_affine_lt_add_one (a b : ℝ) (n : Nat) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    (⌈a * (n : ℝ) + b⌉₊ : ℝ) < a * (n : ℝ) + max 0 b + 1

rows.name: Resources.RoundedRecurrence.ceil_affine_lt_of_threshold
rows.raw_header:
theorem ceil_affine_lt_of_threshold (a b : ℝ) (N n : Nat)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha_lt_one : a < 1)
    (threshold : (max 0 b + 1) / (1 - a) ≤ (N : ℝ)) (large : N < n) :
    ⌈a * (n : ℝ) + b⌉₊ < n

rows.name: Resources.RoundedRecurrence.thresholds_of_combined_cutoff
rows.raw_header:
theorem thresholds_of_combined_cutoff (a b c d : ℝ) (N : Nat)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c) (contract : a + c < 1)
    (threshold : (max 0 b + max 0 d + 2) / (1 - a - c) < (N : ℝ)) :
    (max 0 b + 1) / (1 - a) ≤ (N : ℝ) ∧
      (max 0 d + 1) / (1 - c) ≤ (N : ℝ)

rows.name: Resources.RoundedRecurrence.ceil_children_lt
rows.raw_header:
theorem ceil_children_lt (a b c d : ℝ) (N n : Nat)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c) (contract : a + c < 1)
    (threshold : (max 0 b + max 0 d + 2) / (1 - a - c) < (N : ℝ))
    (large : N < n) :
    ⌈a * (n : ℝ) + b⌉₊ < n ∧ ⌈c * (n : ℝ) + d⌉₊ < n

rows.name: Resources.RoundedRecurrence.cutoff_denominator_pos
rows.raw_header:
theorem cutoff_denominator_pos (a b c d : ℝ) (N : Nat) (contract : a + c < 1)
    (threshold : (max 0 b + max 0 d + 2) / (1 - a - c) < (N : ℝ)) :
    0 < (1 - a - c) * (N : ℝ) - max 0 b - max 0 d - 2

rows.name: Resources.RoundedRecurrence.slope_nonneg_and_margin
rows.raw_header:
theorem slope_nonneg_and_margin (a c C1 C3 : ℝ) (contract : a + c < 1)
    (toll_nonneg : 0 ≤ C1) (slope : C1 / (1 - a - c) ≤ C3) :
    0 ≤ C3 ∧ 0 ≤ C3 * (1 - a - c) - C1

rows.name: Resources.RoundedRecurrence.sharp_affine_absorption
rows.raw_header:
theorem sharp_affine_absorption (a b c d C1 C2 C3 C4 : ℝ) (N n : Nat)
    (contract : a + c < 1) (toll_nonneg : 0 ≤ C1)
    (threshold : (max 0 b + max 0 d + 2) / (1 - a - c) < (N : ℝ))
    (slope : C1 / (1 - a - c) ≤ C3)
    (absorb : (C1 * (N : ℝ) + C2 + C4) /
      ((1 - a - c) * (N : ℝ) - max 0 b - max 0 d - 2) ≤ C3)
    (large : N ≤ n) :
    (C3 * (a * (n : ℝ) + max 0 b + 1) + C4) +
      (C3 * (c * (n : ℝ) + max 0 d + 1) + C4) + C1 * (n : ℝ) + C2 ≤
        C3 * (n : ℝ) + C4

rows.name: Resources.RoundedRecurrence.recurrence_step_le
rows.raw_header:
theorem recurrence_step_le (f : Nat → ℝ) (a b c d C1 C2 C3 C4 : ℝ) (N n : Nat)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (contract : a + c < 1) (toll_nonneg : 0 ≤ C1)
    (threshold : (max 0 b + max 0 d + 2) / (1 - a - c) < (N : ℝ))
    (slope : C1 / (1 - a - c) ≤ C3)
    (absorb : (C1 * (N : ℝ) + C2 + C4) /
      ((1 - a - c) * (N : ℝ) - max 0 b - max 0 d - 2) ≤ C3)
    (large : N ≤ n)
    (recurrence : f n = f ⌈a * (n : ℝ) + b⌉₊ + f ⌈c * (n : ℝ) + d⌉₊ +
      C1 * (n : ℝ) + C2)
    (left_bound : f ⌈a * (n : ℝ) + b⌉₊ ≤ C3 * (⌈a * (n : ℝ) + b⌉₊ : ℝ) + C4)
    (right_bound : f ⌈c * (n : ℝ) + d⌉₊ ≤ C3 * (⌈c * (n : ℝ) + d⌉₊ : ℝ) + C4) :
    f n ≤ C3 * (n : ℝ) + C4

rows.name: Examples.RoundedRecurrence.zero_recurrence
rows.raw_header:
theorem zero_recurrence (n : Nat) :
    (fun _ : Nat => (0 : ℝ)) n =
      (fun _ : Nat => (0 : ℝ)) ⌈(1 / 4 : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) + 0⌉₊ +
      (fun _ : Nat => (0 : ℝ)) ⌈(1 / 4 : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) + 0⌉₊ + 0 * (n : ℝ) + 0

rows.name: Resources.RoundedRecurrence.explicit_cutoff_bounds
Resources.RoundedRecurrence.affine_bound_of_prefix
rows.raw_header:
theorem affine_bound_of_prefix (f : Nat → ℝ)
    (a b c d C1 C2 C3 C4 : ℝ) (n0 N : Nat)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c) (contract : a + c < 1) (toll_nonneg : 0 ≤ C1)
    (cutoff : n0 ≤ N)
    (threshold : (max 0 b + max 0 d + 2) / (1 - a - c) < (N : ℝ))
    (prefix : ∀ n, n ≤ N → f n ≤ C4)
    (slope : C1 / (1 - a - c) ≤ C3)
    (absorb : (C1 * (N : ℝ) + C2 + C4) /
      ((1 - a - c) * (N : ℝ) - max 0 b - max 0 d - 2) ≤ C3)
    (recurrence : ∀ n, n0 < n →
      f n = f ⌈a * (n : ℝ) + b⌉₊ + f ⌈c * (n : ℝ) + d⌉₊ +
        C1 * (n : ℝ) + C2) :
    ∀ n : Nat, f n ≤ C3 * (n : ℝ) + C4

rows.name: Resources.RoundedRecurrence.bound_with_source_constants
rows.raw_header:
theorem bound_with_source_constants (f : Nat → ℝ)
    (a b c d C1 C2 : ℝ) (n0 : Nat)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c) (contract : a + c < 1) (toll_nonneg : 0 ≤ C1)
    (recurrence : ∀ n, n0 < n →
      f n = f ⌈a * (n : ℝ) + b⌉₊ + f ⌈c * (n : ℝ) + d⌉₊ +
        C1 * (n : ℝ) + C2) :
    let N : Nat := max n0 (⌈(max 0 b + max 0 d + 2) / (1 - a - c)⌉₊ + 1)
    let C4 : ℝ := (Finset.range (N + 1)).sup'
      ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.succ_pos N)⟩ f
    let C3 : ℝ := max (C1 / (1 - a - c))
      ((C1 * (N : ℝ) + C2 + C4) /
        ((1 - a - c) * (N : ℝ) - max 0 b - max 0 d - 2))
    ∀ n : Nat, f n ≤ C3 * (n : ℝ) + C4

rows.name: Resources.RoundedRecurrence.exists_affine_bound
rows.raw_header:
theorem exists_affine_bound (f : Nat → ℝ) (a b c d C1 C2 : ℝ) (n0 : Nat)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c) (contract : a + c < 1) (toll_nonneg : 0 ≤ C1)
    (recurrence : ∀ n, n0 < n →
      f n = f ⌈a * (n : ℝ) + b⌉₊ + f ⌈c * (n : ℝ) + d⌉₊ +
        C1 * (n : ℝ) + C2) :
    ∃ C3 C4 : ℝ, ∀ n : Nat, f n ≤ C3 * (n : ℝ) + C4

rows.name: Resources.RoundedRecurrence.exists_affine_bound_nat
rows.raw_header:
theorem exists_affine_bound_nat (f : Nat → Nat) (a b c d : ℝ) (C1 C2 n0 : Nat)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c) (contract : a + c < 1)
    (recurrence : ∀ n, n0 < n →
      f n = f ⌈a * (n : ℝ) + b⌉₊ + f ⌈c * (n : ℝ) + d⌉₊ + C1 * n + C2) :
    ∃ C3 C4 : Nat, ∀ n : Nat, f n ≤ C3 * n + C4

rows.raw_header: noncomputable def roundedQuarter (n : Nat) : Nat

rows.name: Examples.RoundedRecurrenceBounds.roundedQuarter_of_five_lt

theorem roundedQuarter_of_five_lt (n : Nat) (large : 5 < n) :
    roundedQuarter n = roundedQuarter ⌈(1 / 4 : ℝ) * (n : ℝ)⌉₊ +
      roundedQuarter ⌈(1 / 4 : ℝ) * (n : ℝ)⌉₊ + n + 1

rows.name: Examples.RoundedRecurrenceBounds.noncontracting_affine_step_impossible
rows.raw_header:
theorem noncontracting_affine_step_impossible (A B : ℝ) (N : Nat) :
    ¬ ∀ n : Nat, N < n →
      (A * (⌈(1 / 2 : ℝ) * (n : ℝ)⌉₊ : ℝ) + B) +
        (A * (⌈(1 / 2 : ℝ) * (n : ℝ)⌉₊ : ℝ) + B) + (n : ℝ) ≤
          A * (n : ℝ) + B
